name: CI/CD

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

env:
  DOTNET_VERSION: '8.0.x'
  DOCKER_REGISTRY: ghcr.io

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:

        with: { fetch-depth: 0 }

        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with: { dotnet-version: ${{ env.DOTNET_VERSION }}, cache: true }

        run: dotnet restore

        run: dotnet build --no-restore -c Release

        run: dotnet test --no-build -c Release --filter "FullyQualifiedName~UnitTests" --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage"

        run: dotnet test --no-build -c Release --filter "FullyQualifiedName~IntegrationTests"

        run: dotnet test --no-build -c Release --filter "FullyQualifiedName~ArchitectureTests"

        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4

  security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:


        run: dotnet nuget audit --level high

        run: trivy fs --severity HIGH,CRITICAL .

  performance-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build-and-test
    steps:


        with: { dotnet-version: ${{ env.DOTNET_VERSION }} }

        run: dotnet run -c Release --project tests/MyProject.PerformanceTests -- --filter **

  docker-build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [build-and-test, security-scan]
    if: github.event_name == 'push'
    steps:


        run: docker build -f docker/Dockerfile.api -t ${{ env.DOCKER_REGISTRY }}/${{ github.repository }}/api:${{ github.sha }} .

        run: docker build -f docker/Dockerfile.worker -t ${{ env.DOCKER_REGISTRY }}/${{ github.repository }}/worker:${{ github.sha }} .

        run: |
          trivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL ${{ env.DOCKER_REGISTRY }}/${{ github.repository }}/api:${{ github.sha }}
          trivy image --severity HIGH,CRITICAL ${{ env.DOCKER_REGISTRY }}/${{ github.repository }}/worker:${{ github.sha }}

        run: |
          echo ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} | docker login ${{ env.DOCKER_REGISTRY }} -u ${{ github.actor }} --password-stdin
          docker push ${{ env.DOCKER_REGISTRY }}/${{ github.repository }}/api:${{ github.sha }}
          docker push ${{ env.DOCKER_REGISTRY }}/${{ github.repository }}/worker:${{ github.sha }}

  deploy-staging:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: docker-build
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/develop'
    steps:

        run: helm upgrade --install myproject-staging helm/myproject -n staging --set image.tag=${{ github.sha }}

  deploy-production:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: docker-build
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    environment: production
    steps:

        run: helm upgrade --install myproject-prod helm/myproject -n production --set image.tag=${{ github.sha }}

**Как работает:** async fn fetch() -> Result<Data> { let resp = reqwest::get(url).await?; resp.json().await }
